austin.summary: Austin, drafting fifth from the tail of the snake, you swung boom-or-bust and got both. Jenna at pick #6 ranks 17 of 21 — that one stung, and a 2 draft GPA tells the story. But Eric at pick #16 ranks 1 of 21, and that's a steal, period. You sit rank 3 of 5 with 43 counted points, out of contention with 19 points still on the table and the leader at 63. Ep 3 brought +8, Ep 6 only +2. Pride's still in play.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Eric, your sixteenth-pick mental health counselor, leads all 21 players with 17 pts and is the one name of your four still in the game.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Jenna went 4th voted out in Ep 4 for 4 pts and a grade F, a brutal return on a pick #6, and Linnea followed one episode later with 6 pts.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Those 19 points still on the table ride entirely on Eric — watch whether that charisma and emotional intelligence keep stacking him up at rank 1 of 21.

kylie.summary: Kylie, you took Aaliyah at pick #3 and watched her go home first — First Blood, and it stung. But then you landed Cristian at #8, and he's sitting at 17 pts, rank 1 of 21, the steal of this entire draft. You're rank 4 of 5 with 35 counted points, eliminated from contention with the leader at 63, but 19 points are still on the table and Cristian is still out there making noise. Ep 7 gave you +8. That's the fight in this team.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Cristian — fun, chaotic, loud, 17 pts and the number one scorer of all 21 castaways — has single-handedly kept this roster breathing.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Aaliyah went out first at Ep 1 with 0 pts and a grade of F, and a pick #3 that produces nothing is a hole you spend a whole season climbing out of.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: With 1 of 4 still in the game and 19 points left on the table, every move Cristian makes is your whole story now.

tami.summary: Tami, you had first pick and you built a Tovuto wall — Jelly, Mike and Sharonda all sitting at 17 pts, all ranked 1 of 21, all three still in the game. That's 54 counted points, rank 2 of 5, with the leader at 63 and 37 points still on the table. Ep 7 gave you +12, Ep 4 gave you +3, and your draft GPA is 2.4. You're right there.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Sharonda was the leftover at pick #21 and she's grading out an A with 17 pts, rank 1 of 21 — the steal of this entire draft.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Patt went at pick #10 and finished 3rd voted out in Ep 3 with 3 pts, rank 18 of 21 and a grade of F, while Rob's 2 pts get dropped under the best-4 rule.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Your roster already owns Immunity Hoarder with 3 necklaces and Idol Whisperer with 2 found — keep that hardware coming from the Tovuto three.

taylor.summary: Taylor, I've got to say it straight: your torches are all snuffed. Zero of 4 still in the game, 31 counted points, rank 5 of 5, and the leader sitting on 63. But what a ride — Ep 7 gave you a season-best +7, Ep 8 gave you +0, and your crew still hauled in two badges: Torch Collector with 4 torches snuffed and Idol Whisperer with 2 found. Loud, chaotic, unforgettable.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Kristin Flickinger, the oldest player of the season, led your roster with 12 pts and outlasted everyone you drafted, going out 9th & 10th voted out as 1st & 2nd jury members.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Ana Sani went 2nd voted out in Ep 2 for just 1 pts at rank 20 of 21, and taking Kristin at pick #2 when she ranks 12 left your draft GPA at 1.25.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: With 0 points still on the table, the only thing left to savor is Brady Booker — pick #19, ranks 13, grade A — the steal that proves you can find gold late.

tim.summary: Tim, you drafted an entire Tovuto household and it's paying rent. Rank 1 of 5, 63 counted points, and badges stacked to the rafters: Merge Machine, Wire-to-Wire, Jury Duty, Idol Whisperer. Every castaway you took made the merge, your roster found 2 idols and advantages, and Ep 7 handed you +16. Thien An at pick #17 was highway robbery. Two of four still breathing, 28 points still on the table. That's a draft.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Devin Way and Thien An are both sitting at 17 pts and tied at rank 1 of 21 — you don't have one engine, Tim, you have two.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Lewis at pick #4 was your reach, ranking 10 with 14 pts and a grade D before going out 3rd jury member in Ep 9, and your 2.75 draft GPA wears that.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: You've got 2 jurors already seated and 28 points still on the table — watch whether Devin and Thien An can keep splitting the top rank while that jury grows.
